verdict.rationale: a-Shell ships its own Apple Shortcuts actions for unattended automation. `Execute Command` runs a list of commands or a script file, and `Put File`/`Get File` move files in and out. Shortcuts can be forced to run "in Extension" without the app UI, though the docs warn this won't always work. Missing for 10: any CLI/headless binary or CI-runner integration, automation outside the iOS Shortcuts host, reliability guarantees for extension mode, and independent hands-on corroboration.
